import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.00)

# 1. Survival rate by passenger class and sex
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
survival_by_class_sex = df.groupby(['pclass', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().reset_index()
survival_pivot = survival_by_class_sex.pivot(index='pclass', columns='sex', values='survived')
survival_pivot.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#ff9999', '#66b3ff'], width=0.7)
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_xticklabels(['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'], rotation=0)
ax1.legend(title='Gender', labels=['Female', 'Male'])
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)

# 2. Age distribution by survival
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
survived_ages = df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'].dropna()
died_ages = df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'].dropna()
ax2.hist([died_ages, survived_ages], bins=20, label=['Died', 'Survived'], 
         color=['#ff6b6b', '#51cf66'], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=10)
ax2.legend()
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Survival rate by embarkation port
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
embark_survival = df.groupby('embarked')['survived'].agg(['sum', 'count']).reset_index()
embark_survival['rate'] = embark_survival['sum'] / embark_survival['count']
embark_labels = {'S': 'Southampton', 'C': 'Cherbourg', 'Q': 'Queenstown'}
embark_survival['embarked_full'] = embark_survival['embarked'].map(embark_labels)
embark_survival = embark_survival.dropna()
bars = ax3.bar(embark_survival['embarked_full'], embark_survival['rate'], 
               color=['#4ecdc4', '#ff6b6b', '#ffe66d'], edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.5)
ax3.set_title('Survival Rate by Port of Embarkation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Embarkation Port', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
# Add count labels on bars
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars, embark_survival['count'])):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.02,
             f'n={int(count)}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 4. Fare distribution by class and survival
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
for pclass in sorted(df['pclass'].unique()):
    survived_fare = df[(df['pclass'] == pclass) & (df['survived'] == 1)]['fare']
    died_fare = df[(df['pclass'] == pclass) & (df['survived'] == 0)]['fare']
    
violin_data = []
positions = []
labels_list = []
colors = []
pos = 0
for pclass in sorted(df['pclass'].unique()):
    for survived in [0, 1]:
        data = df[(df['pclass'] == pclass) & (df['survived'] == survived)]['fare'].dropna()
        if len(data) > 0:
            violin_data.append(data)
            positions.append(pos)
            labels_list.append(f'Class {pclass}\n{"Died" if survived == 0 else "Survived"}')
            colors.append('#ff6b6b' if survived == 0 else '#51cf66')
            pos += 1
    pos += 0.5

parts = ax4.violinplot(violin_data, positions=positions, widths=0.7, showmeans=True)
for pc, color in zip(parts['bodies'], colors):
    pc.set_facecolor(color)
    pc.set_alpha(0.6)
ax4.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class and Survival', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Passenger Class & Status', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare (£)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_xticks([0.5, 2.5, 4.5])
ax4.set_xticklabels(['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'])
ax4.set_ylim(0, 300)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Add custom legend
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_elements = [Patch(facecolor='#ff6b6b', alpha=0.6, label='Died'),
                   Patch(facecolor='#51cf66', alpha=0.6, label='Survived')]
ax4.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper right')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
